hypothesis.statement: Without evidence-bound keep/reject rules, repeated character edits can become random tweaking and silently regress deformation or runtime guardrails.
hypothesis.action: Separate target and guardrail metrics, verify deltas, force unscored comparisons to inconclusive and allow keep only for meaningful target gains without regressions or blockers.
hypothesis.expectedResult: v001 becomes an explicit baseline and future iterations receive deterministic keep, reject or inconclusive decisions.

decisionRules: keep requires every target metric to improve by at least the meaningful delta
any target or guardrail regression rejects the iteration
any blocking defect rejects the iteration
declared deltas must exactly match before and after values
decision: Keep the decision engine and use v001 only as baseline; do not label it an accepted AAA iteration.
nextEvidence: v002 with a single stated MetaHuman conform hypothesis, scored target and guardrail evidence, actual deltas and deterministic keep/reject/inconclusive result
